other_conditions: Must work in private, leased, or government ponds/watersheds
Must be an active member of Block Level Fishermen Cooperation Committees
Should have successfully undergone training under departmental schemes
Should have adequate fish resources available for farming
Can avail the benefit of this scheme only once
benefits_summary: Provides a two‑day educational tour that introduces fish farmers to the latest fisheries techniques, helping increase production, income and employment opportunities.
